TaskDescription: Intraoperative microelectrode recording (MER) at one depth position during stereotactic deep brain stimulation surgery targeting the subthalamic nucleus (STN) in Parkinson's disease.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Microelectrode trajectory towards the left subthalamic nucleus during DBS surgery; this depth was classified outside the STN (STN-OUT) by the neurophysiologists and surgeons (release description).
RecordingDescription: Release file data/Left_lobe/Left_lobe_STN_OUT/P13L_STN_OUT/00353.mat; depth label (file name) 00353; STN-OUT. Channel lengths in samples: [264654, 264654, 265408]. Channels differ in length in the release. Since Oct 2026 this file is cropped to the shortest channel (264654 samples; 754 samples of the longer channels after that point are left out; they remain in the release .mat in sourcedata). All channels are written from their first sample (alignment of channels of unequal length is not documented).
